scope: Prospective real pinned stb_divide scalar kernel, synthetic full-int32 batch workload; not a production application trace or general Hepta speed claim.
formal_materialization: Only after exact implementation, controls and this protocol are remotely committed. Seed declared before workload generation. Do not rerun or exclude failed attempts.
selection: Top three static arms by complete summed training invocation cost before holdout materialization. First is primary, all three form a pointwise fastest envelope; no post-holdout candidate or baseline selection.
order: Rotate [three preselected static arms, HIA] by context+repetition, pinned one allowed logical CPU. Shared host exclusivity not attested.
candidate: One independently proved guarded constant-divisor specialization per context; same algorithm and compilation profile for every context, no performance-guided formal search.
costs: Charge entire source identity, native tool probes, whole-library migration, all eighteen static builds including PGO training, baseline selection, proposal/proof/lowering/compile and preflight validation as conservative candidate preparation. Runtime comparisons include sealing, process startup, DSO load/switch, warmup, actual kernel, full-output observation, buffer/DSO/memfd cleanup. Retained evidence files are not live runtime resources; archive cost separate. Whole Python observation calls are timed, including artifact identity/hash and JSON parsing. Every remaining timed-phase orchestration/checkpoint cost is charged conservatively to the candidate. The savings reduction, final source/tool identity and affinity restoration are charged. A final actual wall-budget check gates every benefit claim. Human/AI engineering and earlier cached toolchain acquisition are unknown, so this is controller machine-time economics, not total project ROI.
benefit_gate: All required executions correct with stable registered source, total pointwise static-envelope savings exceeds every charged preparation/final-identity cost, and each context has positive summed envelope savings. This is observed net wall time on actual measured horizon, not a statistical confidence or future guarantee.
safety_scope: All 2^64 scalar input pairs preserve exact checked-divide behavior through exhaustive guard, including miss/failure cases. Selected internal LLVM bodies checked. Actual C batch bridge, inlining hint, LTO, machine code, kernel and hardware remain trusted/finite-tested. No owned resource operation is introduced.

pgo_training.tasks: same four disclosed training contexts; separate from 4096-round baseline-selection training
